name: Geometric State Space Projection
description: Converts boolean literals and OR-clauses into 2D projections of a state vector, where constraints are evaluated as squared Euclidean distances to target points in a hypercube. By defining the target coordinates algebraically via a sign-based fraction, this forces the model to mathematically analyze the distance constraint to uncover the underlying 2-SAT logic, completely preventing direct pattern matching of signed integers to boolean variables.
